_comment: Announcement: ROTATING, three messages (shipping · social proof · provenance).

The wordmark is deliberately bilingual — SIWA سيوة — because the bottles
are. This is the ONE sanctioned exception to the one-language-at-a-time
rule: a brand lockup is a mark, not content. Headings, body copy and
product text stay single-language and translate through Translate & Adapt.
